current_program:
PROJECT_ROOT="$PWD"
python3.11 -m venv "$PROJECT_ROOT/.venv"
source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.venv/bin/activate"
python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
python -m pip install \
  -r "$PROJECT_ROOT/requirements.txt" \
  -r "$PROJECT_ROOT/tests/requirements.txt" \
  flake8 pyright boto radosgw-admin
ANSIBLE_MODULE_UTILS_DIR="$(python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ansible.module_utils
print(Path(ansible.module_utils.__file__).resolve().parent)
PY
)"
cp "$PROJECT_ROOT/module_utils/ca_common.py" "$ANSIBLE_MODULE_UTILS_DIR/ca_common.py"
export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT:$PROJECT_ROOT/library:$PROJECT_ROOT/module_utils:$PROJECT_ROOT/plugins/filter${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"
unset ANSIBLE_MODULE_UTILS_DIR PROJECT_ROOT
